references.text: Parallel verses describing killing with iron tools and stones, the same principle of capital punishment for the murderer
Reiterates the principle that the murderer must die; the avenger of blood shall kill the killer
Elaborates on the law of capital punishment for murderers and forbids ransom for a murderer's life
Fundamental law prescribing capital punishment for one who strikes a man down to death
The principle that whoever takes a human life must die
Law regarding premeditated murder and the delivery of the murderer to the avenger of blood
Fundamental principle that whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed
